item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 29/Apr/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will continue to affect the coast of southern China tomorrow. Winds will be weak and the weather will be hot over the coast of Guangdong in the following few days. Meanwhile, under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, there will be a few showers over Guangdong. A trough of low pressure is expected to develop gradually over central China over the weekend, and bring showers and thunderstorms to Guangdong early next week.
